title: Carter Bryant on the NBA: 'You can't survive if you don't have a short-term memory in this league'
text:
Carter Bryant on the NBA: 'You can't survive if you don't have a short-term memory in this league' Rumors News & Analysis Salaries Player Rankings NBA 2K Rankings Free Agency NBA RUMORS Carter Bryant on the NBA: 'You can't survive if you don't have a short-term memory in this league'
 HoopsHype Oct. 12, 2026, 5:54 p.m. ET Bryant said the biggest thing he gained from the playoffs is how important it is to move on quickly after giving up a basket or blowing an assignment. "(Spurs assistant coach) Mike Noyes says it a lot: Have a next-play mentality," Bryant said. "It's understanding that those guys I'm defending are the best in the world. They're supposed to make tough shots, so I'm just moving on to the next play, not dwelling on something I have no control over. I'm going to play defense to the best of my abilities. If they make the shot, they make the shot. That's what they're supposed to do. They're getting paid $200 million, $300 million to do that. "You can't survive if you don't have a short-term memory in this league."
